content.short: Marsbirds aims to enhance Cardano's gaming and staking experience, focusing on community values and utility-driven features.
content.description:
MarsBirds is a community of birds from all over the universe that have landed on Mars. Whether you're a seasoned collector or new to the world of NFTs, or a casual gamer, we have something for everyone.

Marsbirds is a collection of 8888 unique and on-chain stored NFTs, each with their own traits and abilities. The project started with an 8 ADA mint and has since grown to include a fully-functional survival game, staking, and a burn/claiming service for their $MARS token.

With the upcoming 3D Marsbirds public mint and the highly-anticipated battle royale mode set to release later this year, the Marsbirds are ready to survive on the red planet and offer collectors and gamers alike a unique and exciting experience.
